{{Quote|Dee? You came for me. I knew you would...|Draylen|<ref name="Rulebook" />}}
'''Draylen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] and friend of [[MHD-19/Legends|MHD-19]]. Several years before<ref name="Preventative Measures" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/star-wars-imperial-assault/products/return-hoth|text=Return to Hoth}} for [[Return to Hoth (expansion)|''Return to Hoth'']] states that the events take place in the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth, which [[The New Essential Chronology]] dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Draylen encountered MHD-19, a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] in forced servitude, and liberated him. Draylen and MHD-19 became a loyal friends,<ref name="Preventative Measures" /> with Draylen giving MHD-19 the nickname "Dee."<ref name="Rulebook">{{SWIA|set=Return to Hoth|rulebook=1}}</ref> The two eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In 3 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Draylen, now a Rebel operative, was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] while on a mission. He was imprisoned in a holding facility on [[Tro'Har]]<ref name="Preventative Measures" /> where he awaited execution.<ref name="Rulebook" />

{{RPG}}
Determined to save his friend, MHD-19 traveled to the facility with the help of [[Verena Talos/Legends|Verena Talos]] and [[Loku Kanoloa/Legends|Loku Kanoloa]]. The group fought the Imperial forces and rescued Draylen. Dazed and tired, Draylen told MHD-19 the he knew he would come to rescue him; then succumbed to his exhaustion and fell asleep. MHD-19 then began to dutifully attend to Draylen's injuries.<ref name="Rulebook" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's not your fault, Dee.|Draylen before passing away in an alternate ending of the side mission|<ref name="Rulebook" />}}
Draylen appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' expansion set [[Return to Hoth (expansion)|''Return to Hoth'']]<ref name="Rulebook" /> released on [[December 23]], [[2015]]<ref name="Back on the Ice">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/12/23/back-on-the-ice|text=Back on the Ice}}</ref> in the provided rulebook as part of the "Preventative Measures" side mission.<ref name="Rulebook" />

This article assumes a specific path is taken in the roleplaying adventure. This article assumes that the players successfully rescue Draylen. If they players are unsuccessful, then Draylen gets executed. A dying Draylen will tell MHD-19 that it is not his fault before passing away, leaving MHD-19 inconsolable for [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="Rulebook" />
